evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback opposed to a rollback one does not have — matched structure ('a rollback we…') across both clauses.
Condensed label formula packaging cadence + system + activity into a single recurring noun-phrase — the org's signature compressed decision-record phrasing.
